title: ICPC (International Collegiate Programming Contest)
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the public ICPC contest format and topic areas. Not a capture of past contest problems.

items.stem: A dynamic multiset of 10 elements needs rank and point updates. Which structure gives best worst-case complexity?
options: A Fenwick Tree (or Segment Tree) with order statistics
items.explanation: This choice achieves the required complexity while satisfying contest time and memory constraints.
items.reference: ICPC Topic Areas - Data Structures and Algorithms
